judge_criteria.selection: Use source and context: distinguish similar subjects, preserve action cause and the temporal order of new visual evidence; assess selection_audit actual evidence and omissions, not writing quality alone.
judge_criteria.sound_protection: Listen to source and output; preserve dialogue, animal/action/transition sounds. Only single global base gain [-6,0] dB allowed; no local ducking. Risk regions are leads, not exact forbidden intervals.
judge_criteria.language: Actually listen: clear Mandarin, consistent referents, understandable pacing and no repetitive/unsupported statements.

judge_gates.critical_visual_facts: No critical visual relationship/action wrong or omitted; no invented psychology/identity/future outcome.
judge_gates.source_sound: No substantial masking or deletion of dialogue/important sound, no artificially created silence.
judge_gates.chronology: No spoiler from whole-film knowledge. Respect the main scene evidence order, including identity and appearance revelations. Uncertain onset boundaries require actual-video arbitration. No time changes; never defer all key information to end.
judge_gates.actual_description: Actual audio exists and corresponds to displayed VTT and mix, intelligible speed.

task_summary: 264秒Sintel连续洞穴决斗与识别/离开片段，40秒独立前情；无暂停中文口述影像、信息释放、两龙身份追踪与真实声音保护。
